description: This file defines an Angular service class, WebsocketService, that manages a WebSocket connection, handling connection lifecycle, message reception, and event broadcasting via RxJS BehaviorSubject. It also defines a WsEvent type for different WebSocket events.

classes.name: WebsocketService
classes.description: Manages a persistent WebSocket connection for streaming LLM tokens, providing methods for connection management and message transmission.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket connection is currently open.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the backend URL, handling events for open, message, close, and error, and emitting corresponding WsEvents.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a string message over the WebSocket if it is open.
